user.description: Nearby masjid and surau for every person with GPS location and for your Home zone, from the Jejak Masjid community map.

data_description.radius: How far around each person and Home to look, in km (1 to 5; Jejak Masjid caps searches at 5 km).
data_description.scan_interval: How often, in minutes, to check where everyone is. Jejak Masjid is only asked again when someone leaves the area of an earlier search (up to 5 km wide, shared by everyone) or it is a day old.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Jejak Masjid. Check your internet connection and try again.

abort.already_configured: Jejak Masjid is already set up. Only one instance is allowed.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Jejak Masjid is already set up. Only one instance is allowed.

data_description.radius: How far around each person and Home to look, in km (1 to 5; Jejak Masjid caps searches at 5 km).
data_description.scan_interval: How often, in minutes, to check where everyone is. Jejak Masjid is only asked again when someone leaves the area of an earlier search (up to 5 km wide, shared by everyone) or it is a day old.

menu_options.link: Link a Jejak Masjid account (optional, for your stats)
menu_options.person: Change which person the account belongs to

link.title: Link Jejak Masjid account
link.description: Optional. Adds sensors with your own Jejak Masjid stats. Jejak Masjid will email you a sign-in code. Use the email of your Jejak Masjid account.

data_description.account_person: Who this Jejak Masjid account belongs to. The stats sensors are named after them. One account per Home Assistant.

otp.title: Enter the code
otp.description: Enter the code Jejak Masjid sent to {email}.

unlink.title: Unlink account
unlink.description: Home Assistant forgets the sign-in and removes the stats sensors. Your Jejak Masjid account is not changed.

person.title: Account owner
person.description: Pick the person this Jejak Masjid account belongs to.

error.otp_send_failed: Jejak Masjid could not send a code to that email.
error.invalid_otp: That code did not work. Check it and try again.

find_nearby.name: Find nearby
find_nearby.description: Lists the masjid and surau around a person, zone or point, nearest first.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: Person, device tracker or zone to search around. Defaults to Home.

latitude.name: Latitude
latitude.description: Search around this point instead of an entity.

longitude.name: Longitude
longitude.description: Search around this point instead of an entity.

type.name: Type
type.description: Only return this kind of place.

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of places to return.

account_relink.title: Jejak Masjid account sign-in expired
account_relink.description: Your stats sensors stopped updating. Open the Jejak Masjid options, unlink, then link your account again.
